  -- Observation: Heroes Of The Street is 1922; Aanaval Mothiram is either 1990 or 1991.
  -- Thought: Regardless of whether Aanaval Mothiram is 1990 or 1991, 1922 is earlier. The conclusion is clear.
  -- Result: Determined that Heroes Of The Street came out earlier.
